written_before: the re-run of the baseline arm with the 10-family solver binary (no model is involved in that arm)
reason: The committed baseline arm file (S3_formulation_baseline_baseline_cpu.json) was produced with a solver binary that lists only 6 families (binary sha256 478013c4498c...). The model arm (GPU, qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct) was produced with the 10-family binary built from the merged families branch (sha256 999de3f11e7c..., same pinned solver rev 4e3e32de9ff1). Questions on the four new families (pendulum, projectile_drag, kepler, logistic) therefore ended UNVERIFIED for the baseline for a reason unrelated to its formulation. The comparison of the two arms was not like for like.
change: The baseline arm is re-run, deterministically and with no model, using the same 10-family binary as the model arm. The original baseline file is kept unchanged. Both baseline files are reported; the paired tests use the re-run file. No question, threshold, metric, rule or acceptance criterion changes.
notes: The CPU model arm (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b through a private CPU-only server) was attempted and abandoned: every model call hit the 300 s client timeout because the shared machine had no free CPU (load average about 11 on 8 vCPUs). Those records are infrastructure failures, not results, and no CPU arm file is reported. Rule A1 (defined for the CPU arm) is therefore not evaluable.
The model arm was run once, with temperature 0 as pre-registered, one request at a time, through the live node's Ollama in the owner's night window.
